property_summary: For any inputs with a non-empty _tos and when the callee reverts (or returns false), the reference implementation always reverts the transfer call (propagates failure) while the mutant ignores the callee failure; therefore: for every admissible input, calling transfer against a callee that fails must cause transfer(...) to revert (reference satisfies, mutant does not).
change_summary: Replace the external call so it ignores the returned success flag (remove require(_s)), preventing revert when the callee returns false.
